name: vmq
description: A control queue for VMs, devices and screens that several Claude Code sessions share: take a turn before you touch a target, and see the queue in a pane

autoStartMain.title: Start vmq-main automatically
autoStartMain.description: When a session starts and no live session named vmq-main exists, open one in the background (bin/vmq-main --if-absent, permission mode bypassPermissions). It watches the queue, writes reservations and force-releases turns whose holding process is gone. Turn this off to open it yourself with /vmq-main.
